normative_extracts.quote: Run animation frame callbacks, recalculate styles, update layout, paint and composite.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Geometric mutations invalidate Layout+Paint; transform and opacity execute directly on the Compositor Thread.

production_failures.symptom: FPS drop (INP > 200ms) during scrolling or JS animations
production_failures.root_cause: Reading geometric properties (offsetHeight) immediately after DOM writes inside a loop (Layout Thrashing).
production_failures.mitigation: Batch all DOM reads before writes or defer writes to requestAnimationFrame.

production_failures.symptom: Tab crash on iOS/Android mobile devices
production_failures.root_cause: Excessive promotion of hundreds of layers via will-change: transform exhausting GPU VRAM.
production_failures.mitigation: Apply will-change strictly during active transition windows.
